endorsements.name: Nick Harbour
endorsements.label: Win at Reversing: Tracing and Sandboxing through Inline Hooking
endorsements.description: This presentation will discuss a new free tool for Reverse Engineering called API Thief, the "I Win" button for malware analysis. The unique way the tool operates will be explored as well as how it is able to provide better quality data than other tracing tools currently available. Advanced usage of the tool for malware analysis will be demonstrated such as Sandboxing functionality and a new technique for automated unpacking.
